acceptance_criteria: Every Copy button executes under the application's own Content-Security-Policy.
Errors, 404s and CSRF failures render inside the normal layout with navigation.
Destructive setup removal is visually distinct and requires an explicit confirmation.
Successful owner mutations report an outcome to the operator.
Every task view shares one navigation covering all seven task routes.
No page scrolls horizontally at a 390px viewport.
goal: Fix the high and medium UI/UX blind-spot findings recorded on cards UI-2 through UI-13 without weakening the owner boundaries in AGENTS.md.
non_goals: No new framework, build step or asset pipeline.
No new workflow, board, Recall or Learning truth in the UI.
